digest.component_or_area: completion verifier resumption and search frontier exclusion-list mechanism
propositions: Frontier exclusion-list blocks handed to verifier resumptions as evidence within untrusted fences are rendered inert by fence design and do not suppress re-search of already-searched criteria.
Frontier blocks naming files already read act as signposts, causing resuming verifiers to immediately re-read those files, increasing measured re-search overlap rates rather than reducing them.

Cache-seeded resume (locust behavior) already removes the dominant redundancy from re-proving credited criteria; remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be effectively suppressed by data-shaped exclusion lists in untrusted fences.

Across two large real-closed tickets with forced exhaustion (16-step budget), treatment arm (frontier block) showed +78% and +60% relative INCREASE in re-search overlap versus control, failing the predeclared 30% reduction threshold on both tickets.
